item.title: For maintenance: KPLC announces power cuts in parts of 11 counties tomorrow
item.description: Kenya Power announced system maintenance in parts of 11 counties, including Nairobi, Nyeri, Machakos, Kiambu, Nyamira, and Uasin Gishu, on Wednesday, March 25.

item.title: "She's bold" Natembeya adopts 11-year-old who supports "Tawe" movement
item.description: Governor George Natembeya adopts 11-year-old Favour Wangare, pledging education support and mentorship, as her mother celebrates his life-changing generosity.

item.title: Video: Lady's English eloquence while seeking fees for KMTC child excites many
item.description: A widow with four children struggles to find work in the CBD. Despite being a trained chef, she faces hardship. Can our community help her get back on her feet?

item.title: "No-network zones": Airtel tests Starlink direct-to-mobile internet service
item.description: Airtel Africa and SpaceX successfully test Starlink mobile services in Kenya, enabling satellite-to-mobile connectivity in remote areas, with plans for expansion.

item.title: "Anahitaji marafiki waaminifu wa kumsaidia": Ruto ajibu masaibu ya Tuju
item.description: Rais Ruto aliwakashifu washirika wa Raphael Tuju kwa kumpotosha, akihimiza uungwaji mkono wa kweli badala ya unyonyaji wa kisiasa na kukataa madai ya upinzani.

item.title: Heart of gold: Kind medic adopts little boy who came for heart operation alone
item.description: A doctor who met a five-year-old facing heart surgery alone made a life-changing decision that offered him and his five siblings a family they never had.

item.title: Police by bedside: Reprieve for Tuju as court intervenes to block arrest
item.description: Former CS Raphael Tuju wins anticipatory bail of Ksh 200,000 after dramatic arrest, with court citing rights violations; case set for mention on 7 April 2026.

item.title: Video: Viral clip shows woman wailing, crying as beba beba man steals her goods
item.description: Nairobi businesswoman Lilian Musau lost KSh 10,000 worth of customer goods to a deceitful beba beba man. She was captured in a viral video sharing her distress.

item.title: "Lying isn't cool": Flaqo shuts down rumours about him dating Rongai TikToker
item.description: Veteran comedian Flaqo addresses dating rumours with Rongai TikToker Cindi, reveals past heartbreak, and clarifies misconceptions surrounding his private life.

item.title: "Continue visiting": Siaya locals tell Ruto as he unveils multi-billion projects
item.description: President William Ruto unveils multi-billion projects in Siaya to boost Lake Victoria's economy, enhance fisheries, and create jobs, ensuring inclusive development.

item.title: My hubby brought a mistress home to chase me – he didn’t know, he’d be homeless
item.description: After years fighting for her marriage, a woman catches her cheating husband—then he brings his mistress home to kick her out, unaware he’ll be homeless.

item.title: "Niko na siasa zangu": James Orengo amwambia Ruto kwa ujasiri alipozuru Siaya
item.description: Rais William Ruto na gavana wa Siaya James Orengo walikubaliana kuendelea kutekeleza majukumu yao tofauti ya kisiasa wakati wa uzinduzi wa gati ya Usenge.

item.title: "Sukari ilipungua": Tuju akimbizwa Karen Hospital baada ya afya yake kuzorota
item.description: Afya ya waziri wa zamani Raphael Tuju ilizidi kuzorota alipokuwa akipelekwa katika Mahakama ya Kibera kufuatia kukamatwa ghafla. Alikimbizwa Karen Hospital.

item.title: 19 zaidi: Miili 33 yagunduliwa katika kaburi la halaiki Kericho
item.description: Miili thelathini na tatu imepatikana katika kaburi la halaiki Kericho, ambapo mamlaka hapo awali ilikuwa imegundua miili 14. 25 ni ya watoto na 8 ni ya watu wazima.

item.title: Vuguvugu la Niko Kadi lavamia ofisi za IEBC kuhamasisha vijana kujisajili
item.description: Vuguvugu la vijana Kenya almaarufu "Niko Kadi", linalenga kura 18M kufikia 2027 ili kumtoa Ruto na utawala wake na kuharibu mfumo wa siasa za wanasiasa waliozoeleka.
